include(StandartizeDirsStructure)
cache_std_cmake_dir(INSTALL_CMAKEDIR_PFUNIT "pFUnit4-Project")

#find_package(Git REQUIRED QUIET)
find_package(Git REQUIRED QUIET)

include(ExternalProject)

ExternalProject_Add(pFUnit4-Project
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/Goddard-Fortran-Ecosystem/pFUnit.git
  GIT_REMOTE_NAME origin
  GIT_TAG        2cce6d25eae8a2b77ecad4d32c0011ea014bbdec #origin/main
  GIT_PROGRESS   ON
  GIT_SHALLOW    OFF
  INSTALL_DIR ${STAGED_INSTALL_PREFIX}
  CMAKE_ARGS
  -DCMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER=${CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER}
  -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}
  -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}
  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=<INSTALL_DIR>
  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_MESSAGE=${CMAKE_INSTALL_MESSAGE}
  CMAKE_CACHE_ARGS
  -DINSTALL_LIBDIR:PATH=${INSTALL_LIBDIR}
  -DINSTALL_BINDIR:PATH=${INSTALL_BINDIR}
  -DINSTALL_INCLUDEDIR:PATH=${INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}
  -DINSTALL_MODDIR:PATH=${INSTALL_MODDIR}
  -DINSTALL_CMAKEDIR:PATH=${INSTALL_CMAKEDIR_PFUNIT}
  PATCH_COMMAND
  COMMAND ${GIT_EXECUTABLE} checkout .
  COMMAND ${GIT_EXECUTABLE} clean -fdx
  COMMAND
  ${GIT_EXECUTABLE} apply ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/cmake_pfunit_build.patch
  UPDATE_DISCONNECTED ON
  UPDATE_COMMAND ""
  BUILD_ALWAYS OFF
  LOG_DOWNLOAD ON
  LOG_CONFIGURE ON
  LOG_BUILD ON
  LOG_INSTALL ON
  )

include(StandartizeDirsStructure)
cache_package_cmake_config_dir(pFUnit4-Project pFUnit)
